description_en: Creates an error code redirection rule
description_zh: 新增错误码重定向规则
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-error-pages-redirect-rule --site-id 478016908379824 --error-pages-redirect TargetURL=http://example.com/test StatusCode=400 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateErrorPagesRedirectRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en: The name of the rule. You do not need to specify this parameter when adding a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the rule is enabled. You do not need to specify this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The content of the rule, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to specify this parameter when adding a global configuration. This parameter applies to the following scenarios:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq "video.example.com")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

fields.help_en:
The response status code used by the node when responding to the client with a redirection address. Valid values:
400
403
404
405
414
416
500
501
502
503
504
fields.help_zh:
节点给客户端响应重定向地址时候使用的响应状态码。取值范围：
400
403
404
405
414
416
500
501
502
503
504
fields.name: status_code

parameters.help_en: The execution sequence of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence

schema.description_en: The response result of the request
